name: What is fascia and why is it important for my home?

mainEntity.name: What is fascia and why is it important for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fascia is the long, straight board that runs along the lower edge of your roof, just behind the gutters. It serves several crucial purposes: it supports the bottom row of roof tiles or shingles, helps to protect the roof edge and interior from weather damage, and provides an attachment point for your gutters. A well-maintained fascia also contributes to the overall aesthetic appeal of your home, giving it a clean, finished look. Damage to the fascia can lead to water intrusion, pest infestation, and compromise the integrity of your roof system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fascia is the board along your roof's edge that supports the roof and gutters, protecting your home from weather and pests while enhancing its appearance.
